text:
linda: heads-up — VoltEdge sent today's marketplace dump and it's mixing two reporting modes in the same file: cumulative counters per-device and per-tenant delta rows. we need a plan to attribute to the correct customer and avoid double-counting.
samir: can you paste a sanitized sample?
linda: sure — sample snippet below:
```
mode,device_id,tenant_id,ts,units,unit_type,seq
cumulative,VE-GW-09,tenant-A,2026-04-10T00:00:00Z,123456,pulses,9001
delta,VE-GW-09,tenant-A,2026-04-10T00:10:00Z,1200,pulses,evt-9001
cumulative,VE-GW-09,tenant-A,2026-04-10T00:20:00Z,124656,pulses,9002
delta,VE-GW-10,tenant-B,2026-04-10T00:15:00Z,800,pulses,evt-9022
```
zoe: mixing modes in one export is dangerous. If we ingest both cumulative and delta we'll double-bill. we need canonicalization rules: prefer cumulative when available for a device for that day, otherwise compute delta from consecutive cumulative points (with wrap detection), otherwise accept delta when cumulative missing.
anthony: agreed. also tenant_id vs customer_id: some customers run multiple tenants and VoltEdge sometimes reports tenant alias that doesn't match our partner mapping. we need reliable identity resolution (resolver table + fallback via MAC prefix).
voltedge-pm: apologies — older gateways send cumulative counters every 30min and newer firmware emits event-level deltas. we can add `reporting_mode` header per file and a manifest. we'll push a fix to separate cumulative vs delta files going forward (ETA 48h).
samir: ingestion rules proposal:
1) read manifest->reporting_mode. if manifest.mode == cumulative_only: ingest cumulative only and compute deltas for billing (delta = current - last_seen); if manifest.mode == delta_only: ingest delta rows.
2) if mixed_mode file (manifest missing or mode == mixed): prefer cumulative if >=2 cumulative rows for device in 24h window; compute deltas from cumulatives and ignore delta rows for same device/time-range but keep deltas for devices with no cumulatives.
3) implement wrap-around detection for cumulative counters (if new_value < last_seen then assume wrap and add 2^32 or 2^48 per partner-provided counter_size).

pseudocode:
```
if manifest.mode == "cumulative":
  for device rows ordered by ts:
    if value < last_value: value += wrap_offset
    delta = value - last_value
    emit(delta)
elif manifest.mode == "delta":
  emit(delta rows)
else: # mixed
  if count(cumulative rows for device in 24h) >= 2: compute deltas and ignore delta rows in same time windows
  else: accept delta rows
```
zoe: identity resolution: require `tenant_id` to match partner mapping table. if mismatch, attempt resolver: check device registry -> map device_id to customer_id; fallback heuristic: prefix match on tenant alias + org name. tag any heuristically-resolved rows as `identity-heuristic` and surface in reconciliation UI.
anthony: billing-side: conversion: VoltEdge `pulses` -> our `tokens`. they provide a per-device multiplier and time-varying calibration. must carry calibration metadata and apply at ingest. if calibration missing, use partner default and tag `calibration-default`. invoices for heuristic or calibration-default rows go into draft and held for 72h for partner reconciliation. if partner manifest later supplies calibration, run reprocess job and emit invoice adjustments.
billing-bot: alert: voltedge-ingest 2026-04-10T02:10Z -> mixed-mode file detected, 2 devices with wrap-around candidates, 37 rows tagged identity-heuristic. ticket #5993 created.
voltedge-pm: we'll publish separate files and include per-device calibration + counter_size in the manifest starting tomorrow. we can also retro-send per-file manifests for the last 7 days on request.
samir: additional infra items:
- implement wrap_offset lookup per partner and apply safe-guards when inferred wraps are within noise thresholds
- store raw cumulative and delta inputs for audit and reprocessing
- add a "mode-first" ingest flag that prevents delta ingestion when cumulative sequence is authoritative
zoe: reconciliation UI asks: show side-by-side — partner-reported totals (from manifest) vs our computed totals after canonicalization, highlight per-tenant deltas >0.5% and let ops accept partner manifest to reconcile.
anthony: action items:
- linda: ask VoltEdge PM to publish separate cumulative/delta files + include per-device counter_size & calibration in manifest (ETA 48h)
- voltedge-pm: publish retro manifests for last 7 days (ETA 24h)
- samir: implement mixed-mode canonicalization + wrap detection (EOD)
- zoe: show `identity-heuristic` rows in reconciliation UI and add accept-button for partner mapping (next sprint)
- billing-bot/infra: monitor ticket #5993 and alert if mixed-mode files >3 tonight
linda: thanks all — this mixed-mode issue was causing inflated numbers in last dry-run, so let's prioritize. I'll update when VoltEdge confirms manifest delivery. :white_check_mark:
